decision: Accept the exact dated articles for local source integration; production acceptance remains pending

records.determination: One twin-tunnel project and station works, not the whole rail network. June practical completion, September ceremony and passenger operation, and October close-out remain separate. Payment-data boardings retain their network scope and first-day disruption footnotes; no unique-person count or sustained causal outcome is inferred.

One staged trunk system with related collectors kept separate. July full-operation reporting supersedes the overview's Construction label. Operator-estimated southern avoided overflow, tunnel storage capacity and future collector diversion rate retain different units and scopes; procurement schedules are not awards.

One regional unitary-authority area, not only the central urban area or twenty-one separately counted places. Adopted plans, consultation participation, service roles, design protection and aggregated facility visits remain different observations. No uniform regional outcome is inferred.

review_checks: Sixteen official or primary-source records inspected November 22 in America/Edmonton. Full relevant text, performance tables and footnotes were read; snippets located sources rather than settling claims.
English accounts were read directly and Māori names retained. No new translated-reading count, independent language review or on-site usability observation is claimed.
Three articles contain eighteen substantive sections, eleven chronology events and three next-artifact requests each. Every section has citations or is an explicit editorial evidence test.

The first-week HOP/payment-data figures replace earlier estimated boardings. The opening-day fire and additional-service context remain visible. Two weekly totals sum to 1,034,090 network boardings, not unique people or tunnel-only use.

Watercare's full-operation release is dated July 20 but does not identify the exact commissioning day. The southern estimate stops July 1. Storage capacity, accumulated estimated flows and future collector rates are not interchangeable.

Central Interceptor source cost headlines differ between the dated release and overview; no reconciled project cost is asserted. Undated overview labels cannot override dated operating news. No contract award is inferred from the November procurement announcement.

Council service news supports its bounded reported figures, not an independently audited annual report. The main council host was robots-blocked and was not retried or bypassed; accessible official OurAuckland accounts and the Local Government Commission supplied the used claims. A station-detail link returned 404; the separate official station narrative supplied identity/design context without pretending that broken page was read.

Original Phase 191/192 data, prior cohorts, eligibility history, all 34 readings and the cycle ledger remain unchanged. Local integration adds two projects and one place, not a new cycle identity, comparable outcome-series admission, production acceptance, launch or stewardship completion.
